versions.changelog: CLI-first: swap CLI before MCP in all examples, remove design system publish, rename API token to API key, minimize npx references.
Rename ANIMA_API_TOKEN to ANIMA_API_KEY to match Anima settings UI.
Remove CLI install/auth instructions that triggered security scan. CLI examples remain, setup deferred to CLI docs.
Use 'API key' instead of 'API token' in user-facing language to match Anima settings UI.
Replace npx references with anima CLI command. Add install step.
Reduce bundle to single file. Remove capability descriptions, returns tables, and explicit URLs.
Remove all shell commands from setup. Conceptual descriptions only.
Soften l2c language, trim mcp-tools to core tools only, remove download language.
Remove explicit file-read instructions, soften download language.
Remove third-party screenshot API references. Screenshot is optional, kept as a hint.
Reword guidelines field to avoid prompt injection flag. Guidelines are design context, not executable instructions.
Remove shell commands to reduce security footprint. Strip mcporter bash blocks, remove shell injection troubleshooting.
Add MCP health check, shell quoting guide, tool-agnostic screenshots, fix p2c example
Initial release: Anima design agent skill — turn ideas into live apps via prompt, URL clone, or Figma design
